name: Shift
body:
Design manipulation (teleportation); Level 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round/level (D)

DESCRIPTION

You “shift” quickly back and forth between the Material Plane and the Ethereal Plane and look as though you’re winking in and out of reality at random. This functions as a blink spell, except as noted here.

Overload: For every runic charge overloaded into this script, the duration increases by 1 round, the miss chance of your attacks and the chance your spells manifest in the ethereal plane is reduced by 5%, and the chance of you materializing while passing through solid objects is reduced by 5%.
